values.note: FAS camping $12/night with a valid fishing license, $18 without (the split is by fishing license, not residency). FWP's 2026 fee table gives $5 / $7.50 for MT residents 62+, disabled or veterans. The page also lists conservation licenses (MT resident $8, senior/youth $4, nonresident $10).

fees.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39753424 (Facilities & Fees: 'FAS Camping Without Valid Fishing License 18.0', 'FAS Camping With Valid Fishing License 12.0') + https://fwp.mt.gov/binaries/content/assets/fwp/fish/fas/2026-fas-fee-table_adopted.pdf (as previously recorded), read 2026-10-22

booking.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39753424 (Restrictions: 'Stay Limit Maximum stay of 7 days'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: FWP lists a campsite, a toilet (type not stated), drinking water and a gravel boat ramp; ADA accessibility rated 'Difficult'.

facilities.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39753424 (Facilities: 'Campsite', 'Toilet', 'Drinking Water', 'Ramp (Gravel)'; ADA Accessibility 'Difficult Accessibility'), read 2026-10-22

note: Montana FWP fishing access site (196 acres, ~5,200 ft) on the Big Hole River; FWP describes it as 'Dispersed primitive camping' with a 'Steep access road.' Directions (FWP): I-15 at Melrose, mile marker 93, then 6 miles northwest on county road. No trailer length limit published by FWP. --Claude
summary: FWP FishMT page confirms $12/$18 FAS camping, campsite, toilet, drinking water, gravel ramp. Added the 7-day stay limit. Year-round season (manual) unchanged. Not stated: site count, toilet type, trailer length, how sites are taken (derived FCFS left), hookups (derived electric 0 left). Note gained FWP's 'steep access road' / 'dispersed primitive camping' wording and was trimmed of restated facilities, FCFS and fees.
flags: Access/criteria check for a human: FWP's page now describes the site as 'Steep access road. Dispersed primitive camping.' (it still lists 'Campsite' among facilities and publishes no trailer limit). Not an explicit RV restriction, but worth a look at whether a 23-ft motorhome manages the road.
